info.title: MahaSetu Core
info.description: Requesting-service API plus the applicant-session API used by the MahaSetu website. Applicant flow: create request, redirect with launch_reference, exchange it for a session, per department send code, verify code and run check, then complete and return. Results with reasons are available to both the applicant and the requesting service. A failed, partial or otherwise unverified outcome queues an SMS that appears in the simulated message inbox.

post.description: Called by the requesting portal's server. The applicant's mobile number receives one-time codes and result messages and is never echoed in full. The return address comes from the requester registry, never from this body.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Same service, key and normalized payload replay the original transaction. Changed payload returns 409.

201.description: Request accepted. Send the applicant's browser to the MahaSetu website with the launch reference.

get.summary: Retrieve scoped transaction status and department authorizations

post.summary: Cancel an active request; replay cancellation returns same status

get.description: Returns 409 REPORT_PENDING until the transaction is terminal.

post.summary: Exchange a launch reference for an applicant session
post.description: The launch reference stays valid until launch_expires_at and may be exchanged again after a page reload; every exchange issues a fresh short-lived session token. Moves a CREATED transaction to AUTHENTICATION_PENDING. Expired references return 410 LAUNCH_EXPIRED.

201.description: Session issued. The website keeps the token server-side or in an HttpOnly cookie.

get.description: Messages are written to the Core outbox instead of a carrier, so a demonstration can show what an applicant would receive. Recipients are masked and bodies never contain raw department records.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The next_cursor value of a previous page.

get.description: Lists each department, the documents or information the service needs from it and the applicant's progress. The website polls this while a department check is RETRIEVING.

post.summary: Send a one-time code for one department
post.description: Starts a challenge for this transaction, department and purpose. A verified code is the applicant's consent for that department only. Codes are six digits, expire after five minutes and allow three attempts. A new request supersedes the previous challenge after resend_after. Demo deployments may include demo_code so the website can show a banner.

parameters.name: provider_id
parameters.description: Department identifier from the session's department list.

202.description: Code queued as an SMS to the registered mobile.

post.summary: Verify the code and grant consent for one department
post.description: 400 INVALID_CODE for a wrong code, 410 OTP_EXPIRED, 429 OTP_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED (request a new code), 409 NO_ACTIVE_CHALLENGE or ALREADY_AUTHORIZED. Moves the transaction to AUTHORIZED when the first department is granted.

parameters.name: provider_id
parameters.description: Department identifier from the session's department list.

200.description: Code accepted; the department authorization is GRANTED.

post.summary: Retrieve and standardize evidence from one authorized department
post.description: Requires a GRANTED, unexpired authorization (403 AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED otherwise). Departments whose policy needs no authorization may be checked directly. Core calls the department with its own protocol and credentials, retries transient faults within a bounded budget, and normalizes the result. A technical failure leaves the card UNAVAILABLE and can be retried; it never becomes a failed eligibility check. 409 when already RETRIEVING or the transaction is terminal.

parameters.name: provider_id
parameters.description: Department identifier from the session's department list.

post.summary: Decline a department, or revoke a granted consent
post.description: A pending authorization becomes DENIED and a granted one REVOKED. New calls to that department stop; late responses are ignored for decisions and audited. Other departments stay available. 409 when the transaction is terminal.

parameters.name: provider_id
parameters.description: Department identifier from the session's department list.

post.summary: Finish, evaluate and obtain the return address
post.description: Evaluates the standardized evidence with approved, applicable rule versions and moves the transaction to its terminal state. Departments that were declined or not started count as missing evidence. 409 RETRIEVAL_IN_PROGRESS while any department is RETRIEVING. Repeating the call on a terminal transaction returns the same result. If the state is not VERIFIED (or the request was not cancelled), Core queues one result SMS that lists the plain-language reasons.

get.summary: Read the applicant's result with reasons

Requester.description: Server credential bound to one registered requesting service. Scope every read, result and cancellation to that identity.

DashboardClient.description: Server credential held only by the MahaSetu website's server. Never sent to a browser.

ApplicantSession.description: Short-lived opaque token from POST /v1/applicant/sessions. Bound to one transaction; every call is scoped to that transaction, its applicant and its service.

Unauthorized.description: Credential or session missing, invalid or expired

Forbidden.description: Access denied by policy, authorization or ownership

Conflict.description: State conflict, changed payload or duplicate

TransactionState.description: Mirrors states.json. Terminal states have no exits.

LaunchReference.description: Opaque, unguessable and free of evidence. Safe to place in a redirect URL.

applicant_reference.description: Identifier the departments recognize, such as MHSTU0001.

ResultReport.description: VERIFIED is success, FAILED_CHECK is failure and PARTIAL means some checks passed while others failed or remain unresolved. Technical faults appear as NEEDS_REVIEW with a PROVIDER_ reason code and never as FAIL.

message.description: Plain-language reason shown to the applicant and used in the result SMS.

description.description: What the service needs from this evidence.

DepartmentStatus.description: NOT_STARTED: nothing yet. OTP_SENT: code pending. AUTHORIZED: consent given, not retrieved. RETRIEVING: call in progress. COMPLETED: department answered (a missing record is still COMPLETED). DECLINED: applicant declined or revoked. UNAVAILABLE: technical failure; retry.

can_complete.description: False while any department is RETRIEVING.

session_token.description: Opaque bearer token for the applicant session.

demo_code.description: Present only when the deployment is configured for demo disclosure. Never present in a production configuration.

return_url.description: The registered return address with ref=<transaction_reference> appended. Never carries evidence.

message_queued.description: True when a result SMS was queued.
